an5.12:1.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ sekhabalānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ saṃgāhikaṃ etaṃ saṃghātaniyaṃ yad idaṃ paññābalaṃ. 3.
an5.12:2.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave kūṭāgārassa etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ saṃgāhikaṃ etaṃ saṃghātaniyaṃ yad idaṃ kūṭaṃ,
an5.12:2.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ sekhabalānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ saṃgāhikaṃ etaṃ saṃghātaniyaṃ yad idaṃ paññābalaṃ.
an5.12:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 4.
an5.12:3.2: Saddhābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalena, hiribalena . . . ottappabalena . . . viriyabalena . . . paññābalena samannāgatā bhavissāma sekhabalenā ti. Evaṃ
